description:
Cockroaches have been crawling the Earth for over 300 million years — outliving dinosaurs and surviving mass extinctions. But how did these ancient insects evolve, and why have they become one of the most persistent household pests today?
കൂറ . പാറ്റ, വിശേഷങ്ങൾ 
In this video, we explore:
The fascinating evolutionary history of cockroaches
How their biological adaptations helped them survive for millions of years
Their role in ecosystems — both good and bad
Why cockroaches are such notorious pests in modern homes
Common species of cockroaches and how to deal with infestations
Whether you're curious about nature or trying to understand your unwelcome kitchen visitors, this video uncovers the secrets of one of the world's most resilient creatures.
